ctx.x: Jimmie had some musicians that had already made good names for themselves and some that were to become better known later. Those that were better known in the jazz world at the time wre Edwin Wilcox (piano) Albert Morris(Guitar) Charles Parham(bass) Earl Carruthers (baritone sax) Joe Thomas(tenor sax) Omar Simeon, a great New Orleans clarinetist and Russell Bowles(trombone). Those that were to become better known later were Joe Wilder(trumpet) Rennald Jones(trumpet) and Albert(Al)Grey(trombone). The other members…
Russell Green (trumpet) Alfred Cobb (trombone) Nick Brooks (vocalist) and Kirtland Bradford (vocalist).

In March, we hit the road and one of the nighter we did was in Cincinnati. Sy was known there because as a young arranger, he was with Zack White's orchestra in Cincy for quite a spell. Naturally, I was known there because it was where I was raised and started my musical career. I taken Smitte home with me and my ole man and he became good friends from the beginning of their acquaintaince, and Dad made us some of his famous dixie rolls before we left. Dixie rolls was a sort of home made biscuit made with yeast…
